title: Space bounds during counter execution
statement: For every finite Boolean word $x$ and every natural number $i \le |x|$, there is a time $t$ with $t + 2\,\mathrm{count}_{\mathrm{true}}(i.bits) \le 4i$ such that, after $t$ steps, the counter machine started on $x$ is in state $0$, its input head is at position $i+1$, its work-tape head is at position $0$, its work tape contains the binary expansion of $i$, and its output is empty. At every time $u \le t$, the work-tape head position lies between $-2(\mathrm{size}(|x|)+1)$ and $2(\mathrm{size}(|x|)+1)$, inclusive.
